events.name: Bahrain GP (Malaysia) · Race
events.selectedSentence: Sepang turns the Mercedes rivalry into a 56-lap examination of execution.
events.fullSpiel: Antonelli and Russell arrive with the championship fight running through their own garage. Sunday asks a different question from qualifying: who can sustain their pace through an entire Grand Prix? This is the Bahrain event on Malaysian asphalt, so the venue is Sepang rather than Sakhir. The meaningful comparison is the two team-mates' race management, not a replay of Saturday's fastest lap.
